questions.question: By what number must a given number be multiplied to increase the number by 25%.
questions.solution:
**Calculations:**

Let the number be x.

After increasing by 25%,

New number = x + (x × 25%)

⇒ x + (x/4)

⇒ 5x/4

**∴ The number should be multiplied by 5/4.**

questions.question: When two equal amounts are deposited for 5 years and 3 years at a rate of 7% and 9% per annum respectively, and the difference of their simple interest is Rs. 475. Then find the deposited amount.
questions.solution:
Let sum be Rs. x

As we know,

SI = Prt/100

According to the question

(x × 5 × 7)/100 – (x × 3 × 9)/100 = 475

⇒ (35x – 27x)/100 = 475

⇒ 8x/100 = 475

⇒ x = 475 × (100/8)

⇒ x = 5937.5

**Short Trick: **

Let the sum be 100%

According to the question

⇒ 35% - 27% = 475

⇒ 8% = 475

⇒ 100% = 475/8 × 100 = 5937.5

questions.question: A man sold two gifts at Rs. 30 each, on one gift he gained 18%, and on the other gift, he lost 18%. What is his overall gain/loss (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
Total SP = 30 × 2 = 60

CP of first gift = 30 × (100/118) = 25.42

CP of second gift = 30 × (100/82) = 36.58

Total CP = 25.42 + 36.58 = 62

Loss = 62 – 60 = Rs. 2

**Other Method : **

Total CP = 100%

As we know, When one article sold at 18% profit and other 18% loss and selling price of each is same, then loss percentage = (18 × 18)/100 = 3.24%

Total SP in % = 100 – 3.24 = 96.76%

Total SP in Rs. = 30 × 2 = 60

96.76% = 60

⇒ 1% = 60/96.76

⇒ 3.24% = [60/96.76] × 3.24 = Rs. 2 (approx)

questions.question: Find the area and circumference of a circle if the radius is 14 cm. (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
Radius of the circle r = 14 cm

Area of the circle = πr² = (22/7) × 14 × 14 = 616 cm²

Circumference of the circle = 2 πr = 2 × (22/7) × 14 = 88 cm

questions.solution:

PS = PU, QS = QT, RT = RU [tangents]

⇒ QT = (15 – x) cm

⇒ RT = 10 – (15 – x) = x – 5

⇒ RU = (x – 5)

⇒ 17 – x = x

⇒ 2x = 17

⇒ x = 17/2

⇒ x = 8.5 cm

⇒ QT = 15 – 8.5 = 6.5

⇒ RU = 8.5 – 5 = 3.5

questions.question: A trader marks his goods at 60% above the cost price and allows a discount of 25%. What is his gain percent?
questions.solution:

Profit percentage = 60 – 25 – (60 × 25)/100 = 20%

**Detailed Method: **

Let CP of the article be Rs. 100

MP of the article = 100 × (160/100) = Rs. 160

SP of the article = 160 × (75/100) = Rs. 120

Profit = 20%

Profit % = 20/100 × 100 = 20%

questions.question: The averages score in Mathematics of 90 students of sections A and B together is 49. The number of students in A was 25% more than that of B, and the average score of the students in B was 20% higher than that of the students in A. What is the average score of the students in A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average score of students on section A and B = 49

Total number of students in A and B = 90

Number of students in A = 25% more than that of B

The average score of students in B = 20% higher than that of A

**Concept used:**

Average = sum of the elements/number of elements

**Calculation:**

Let the number of students in section B be x.

Let the average score of students in A be y.

Nubmer of students in section A = 125% of B = (5/4) × x

We know, x + (5/4) x = 90

Or, x = 90 × 4/9 = 40

Then, the number of students in section A = 50

Total score of students in section A = 50 × y 

Total score of students in section B = 40 × 120% × y

Total score of students in section B = 40 × (6y/5) = 48y

Total score of all students of A and B = 90 × 49 = 4410

50y + 48y = 98y = 4410 

Or, y = 4410/98 = 45

Thus, the average score of students in class A id 45.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da746ff35b626c82fda56ccad7788de3e284b563eb1872334f8fe51f537bd684.png] 

Let the number of students in section B be 4

Number of students in section A = 4 × (5/4) = 5

Total students = 5 + 4 = 9

Average score in mathematics of 9 students = 49

Let the average score of section A be 5x

Average score of section B = 5x × (6/5) = 6x

According to the question

⇒ 5x × 5 + 6x × 4 = 9 × 49

⇒ 25x + 24x = 9 × 49

⇒ 49x = 9 × 49

⇒ x = 9

Average score of section A = 5 × 9 = 45

**∴ The average score of students in class A is 45.**
